title: changes.jsonl record
description: One edit the AI made to the artifact copy on its own, during the review-and-revise loop. Append-only. The original files are untouched until the person agrees to write back; baseline/ keeps the version the session started from.

round.description: Review round whose findings this edit answers.

summary.description: One line, in Chinese: what changed.

why.description: Why: the problem it fixes, in plain words.

message_ids.description: Discussion messages that led to this edit.

path.description: Artifact file, relative to the session folder (artifact/...).

before.description: Text before the edit (empty for a pure insertion).

after.description: Text after the edit (empty for a pure deletion).

anchor.description: Where the edit sits in the revised copy; for a deletion, the text just before it.

evidence.description: For edits that change numbers or facts: where the new value comes from (re-run command, output file).

project_files.description: Copies of project code or data changed under work/ to produce this edit (never the originals).

status.description: reverted: undone after the person asked (confirm=wrong) or a later round found it wrong.
